slides.para: From 1 January 2027, most staff can claim unfair dismissal after six months' service. It applies to existing staff as well as new starters.
bullets: Anyone with 6 months' service on 1 January is protected straight away.
Probation doesn't stop a claim. Service does.
The cap on compensation is removed.
Whistleblowing or pregnancy dismissals are already unfair from day one.
